summary:
Turn 28 reviewed the first check of the new applied-effect claim, which is the last unreviewed result.

State on entry. The third claim C3-applied-effect-follows-committed-vector now has one artifact (52a176deb66c4588a59d71f8afeb13ab, executed as ef136d1e25924ce59ccedc4fe9e2af2e) with outcome violated and oracle correspondence unreviewed; its retained stream reproduces the observation (applied_state_divergence with peer_value 04, recoverer_value and third_value (void)). The earlier C1 artifact that asserted the same property still carries the open scope issue ef6b54abce294555b31a3c9a6ca606ac.

Review judgement (checker_correspondence, no_issue_found). Requirement versus predicate: C3 requires that replicas holding the same instance committed apply the same effect for the instance's key, and the property asserts applied_match on the applied-state event, which the run reports false while the same event prints each replica's committed command, tying the applied difference to the different committed vectors. Entry and caller duties: the harness drives the recovery, accept round and Commit broadcast as before, then applies each record with the real executor and probes the store with a GET; C3's scope now includes applying the instance and excludes the production loop, watermarks, timing and client-visible replies, and the substitutions are declared in the plan. Oracle and identity: the values come from each replica's replicated store for one key fixed by the claim, and the instance identity is shared with the prerequisite reply. Legal history: the committed records are the same driven input as the confirmed C1 checks (recoverer and third replica NOOP, peer PUT). Alternatives and reservations are explicit: the reading that execution lies outside any adoption obligation is exactly why this is its own claim, and the limitations list direct execution instead of the production loop, one instance and one key, and the prepared committed record.

Carried forward. The open issue on the older C1 artifact is deliberately not resolved here: the validator requires a resolution to address an issue on the artifact under review (or its lineage), and 52a176de has no lineage link to 05dc6a36. It is queued for a review of that artifact, where the answer is already established — the applied-state proposition now lives in C3 and must not be used to confirm C1. No requirement, premise or earlier observation was weakened, and audit spec version 6 stands.
